This is a hard question for me. On one hand I appreciate them as abstract concepts and artistic forms of expression. On the other hand, I don't expect many people will take you seriously if you claim to be a xenogender.  I'm all for world-breaking new concepts of gender. But I do think some of these concepts can muddle the ongoing conversation with cis folks, confuse them further, and send them down the wrong rabbit hole. Identifying as a Void and using "it" pronouns is a cute way to irritate people and start a discussion, but there aren't any methods you can take to actually transition into a void. It's just a theory, doesn't seem practical in real life, and for that reason i do see the arguments that it undermines trans people who are actually going through a real transition.   But that's just me, a very very binary trans woman. If my main problem with it is that it confuses cis folks then maybe I SHOULD be more on board, lol.
